notes: A carnival booth where every target is downrange of one throwing line, with no opposing team and no route through, is the target gallery the genre notes point at: Aim Trainer on range-directed, with the ball toss standing in for the gun. The three rows priced 5, 10 and 25 by distance are exactly target-practice's graded distances read left to right, and the ball supply at the bottom middle is station-loadout bent from a weapon bench to a bin of red balls behind the line. The author's enclosed back and side walls keep it compact rather than changing the shape. Decided without a user: nobody walks anywhere here - the player is anchored at the line and swipes - so this is a built set and I appended SET to keep P0 while skipping traversal and jump-gap checks; the point values, the timer and the respawn-in-the-same-row rule are gameplay with no layout footprint, and the stated three rows are recorded here since nothing else in this form holds a count.
